name: Gérard Perrier Industrie S.A.
summary: Gérard Perrier Industrie S.A. engages in design, manufacture, installation, and maintenance of electrical, electronic, automation, and instrumentation equipment in France and internationally. It engages in the engineering, installation, and maintenance of HV/LV distribution networks, electric drive systems, low current systems, and lighting products; and designs and manufacture of electric boxes, cabinets, and modules.
